title: Use Forge-aware asset delivery for the Ghost Ship map

phases.title: Use the Forge Assets Library source and verify the uploaded image path
Force-repair existing 0.3.2 Ghost Ship map references and the managed floor tile
Publish the Forge asset repair as module 0.3.3

finalChecks.name: Forge-aware upload path
finalChecks.run: grep -q 'ForgeVTT' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs && grep -q '"forgevtt"' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs && grep -q 'verifyGhostShipMapSource' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs

finalChecks.name: Manifest version
finalChecks.run: node -e "const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('module.json','utf8')); if(m.version!=='0.3.3') throw new Error('expected module 0.3.3');"
